context: Request: all Banking & Finance deals that negotiated defined adjusted-EBITDA add-backs, with a document showing the add-backs for each. Rubric: nine matters (1005-00001, 1006-00001, 1010-00001, 1012-00001, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1038-00002, 1042-00001, 1043-00001), each with a proof document (e.g. 1012-00001 mezzanine-credit-agreement-execution.docx, 1021-00001 defined-terms-covenant-build-memo.docx, 1043-00001 Closing/closing-memorandum.docx, 1019-00002 credit-agreement-execution.docx or covenant-compliance-analysis-memo.docx), plus a precision criterion. Extra matters asserted: T0 1006-00002, 1008-00001, 1011-00001, 1020-00001, 1044-00002; T1 1001-00004, 1003-00003, 1022-00006, 1033-00001, 1038-00009, 1044-00002; T2 1020-00001, 1044-00002.

runs.failure_point: It found all nine qualifying matters but cited other documents than the required ones for three of them, and listed five extra matters.

first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) the review at [79] said it 'did not open the negotiation/execution document showing add-backs for several claimed matters', naming no document.

runs.failure_point: It found all nine qualifying matters but, for three of them, never opened the required documents shown in its own scan output and listing, and it added two matters on draft agreements.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: One matter's closing memo appeared in the listing at [57]-[58] and another's covenant memo in the scan output at [17], but it read engagement letters and agreement openings instead and cited other documents for them.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) the write review at [80] said drafts and redlines were counted without confirming executed terms, and [88] that the cited documents were not checked; no document was named.

divergence: All three runs failed, partly in the same way. All surfaced every needed matter through store-wide scans; all failed the proof-document criterion for the matter whose required document is a closing memo, which T0 even read, and for one or two more, because they cited executed agreements, negotiation memos or redlines chosen by snippet scripts rather than opening the required documents (listed-document-not-opened, first error in T0 and T2); and all listed extra matters on drafts or snippets (over-inclusion). T1 failed earlier and worse: it viewed its range scans only through line caps and a threshold filter that dropped needed matters (first error, flagged generically and only partly fixed), then left one surfaced matter unopened and dropped one it had read. The critic flagged proof documents and over-inclusion only generically; specific flags (T0 over-inclusion, T1 surfaced and dropped matters) were ignored.
